overview_description.description:
Lightdash is the future of BI - an AI-first, open-source analytics platform that gives modern data teams the fastest path to true self-serve analytics. We integrate seamlessly with dbt and your existing stack, combining an open semantic layer, AI-powered analytics, and the best developer experience in BI.

Lightdash is trusted by fast-growing, data-driven companies worldwide to cut reporting bottlenecks, reduce BI costs, and ship analytics users actually adopt.

product.name: AI Analyst
product.description: An AI-powered assistant that helps users ask data questions in plain English and build reports automatically.

product.name: Embedded Analytics
product.description: A service to embed customizable, secure analytics dashboards and reports into external applications for end users.

product.name: Developer Tooling for dbt Integration
product.description: Tools including CLI, version control, and CI/CD support to manage and deploy dbt projects within the Lightdash platform.
